displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E3.1
diySteps: The heating sequence proves pressure switch 1 and pressure switch 2 open before the inducer starts. E3.1 is the 1st stage switch shorted, not the open-switch code E3.2
Technician: check the 1st stage pressure switch circuit
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Do not jumper a pressure switch.
